about: GTA Online (Delta, GTA history). Take-Two release Oct 29 2013 (SEC): GTA Online launched Oct 1 2013 on Xbox 360 and PS3, 'free with every copy of Grand Theft Auto V'. Rockstar Newswire, Sept 2013 (before launch) (VideoGamer, Sept 25 2013): 'working around the clock to buy and add more servers', 'the first few days even more temperamental than such things usually are'. NBC News, Oct 1 2013: GTA Online 'suffered from lags and complete outages'; Rockstar 'working around the clock to buy and add more servers'. VGC, June 16 2021: Rockstar shut the PS3 and Xbox 360 versions of GTA Online on December 16, 2021. Worthplaying, Nov 5 2026: a new GTA Online Heist Event that week. Strauss Zelnick, Take-Two CEO, earnings call (Insider Gaming Feb 4 2026): 'I have every reason to believe we'll continue to support GTA Online.' Derived: 2013 to 2026 = 13 years. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.text: GTA Online outlived its launch consoles.
